help_text: ℹ️ How does this bot work? 1. The bot polls cheapestinference.com/pools 24/7 over an anonymous Tor/proxy network. 2. Each tier is partitioned into three 8-hour regional blocks (Asia, Europe, Americas). 3. View real-time availability using the interactive dashboard. 4. Under 🔔 My Alerts, configure granular notification rules for entire pools or specific time slots. 5. The moment a slot opens, you receive an instant alert with direct checkout links! 👨‍💻 Contact Author / Support: Telegram: @grizlizora
